children: on Thursday said that the company is encouraged that the United Steelworkers union's bargaining committee has agreed to return to the table on Friday, November 20, adding that it has requested federal mediation on December 14.

The statement from the company added that its 440,000-barrel-per-day oil refinery in Whiting, Indiana, continues to operate safely and reliably, with no impact to operations because of the current labor dispute.

title: BP says union will return to bargaining table on Nov 20
